Package com.miniandmore.app.config

Class ApplicationProperties

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.config.ApplicationProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="application", ignoreUnknownFields=false) public class ApplicationProperties extends Object
Properties specific to Minisandmore.

Properties are configured in the application.yml file. See JHipsterProperties for a good example.
